label: D1 after an a2 -> S1 rare transition, when the agent will choose a2 again
explanation: Reset-gate unit 37 fires only at D1 (never at GO or D2), almost only when the upcoming choice is a2 (99.8% of activation mass) and policy logit strongly favours a2 (choice < -1.5), at medium value. Its main trigger is that the previous trial was a2 that reached S1 via a rare transition (prev_common == 0: 3.3x lift, ~82% of mass). Firing is stronger when that rare trial was unrewarded (rare-unrewarded is the model-based stay signal for a2) than when it was rewarded. Recorded predicate: D1 & upcoming a2 & prev a2 & prev rare. The only future variable is the agent own upcoming choice (action at D1), which is legitimate; dropping it (prev_action == 2 & prev_common == 0 at D1) gives F1 0.70 on dev against 0.73 with it. Most missed mass (~17%) is at the window first D1 (rel -3), where the previous trial is outside the window and cannot be checked; adding rel == -3 raises mass recall to 0.99 but cuts precision to 0.46. False positives are mostly D1 after a2 rare where the agent then switches to a1, or after rare-rewarded trials. It does not fire after a1 trials, after a2 common-rewarded trials, or at GO/D2. The lowest-activation quartile is covered much less (44%) and comes from other a2-stay D1 contexts.
